4A.5 DRP price calculation methodology
The price is calculated as the volume weighted average sale price (expressed in cents and decimals of cents) for a Share,
calculated on all price setting trades of Shares which took place through the NZX Main Board over a period of five
Business Days commencing on 10 September 2026 in accordance with the DRP Terms and Conditions.
4A.6 DRP Price (including any discount):
NZD 2.03910

4A.11a Conditions for DRP participation
Spark New Zealand may, in its absolute discretion, elect not to offer participation under the Plan to Shareholders whose
address is outside New Zealand or Australia.
The full terms and conditions of the DRP as determined by the Spark New Zealand Board are set out in the DRP Offer
